decisions.reason: The two-component injection unit builds directly on the firm's core plural-component pumping and dosing expertise, so it can interpret field feedback and keep improving the unit with its in-house engineering.

This second resin injection unit draws on the same plural-component knowledge base, which makes it easy to absorb customer learning and justifies keeping it alongside A in the construction repair line.
Automatic airless spray guns are central to the firm's established spray application know-how and its industrial customers, so the product fits its existing capabilities closely.
A manual airless gun is a core accessory that the firm deeply understands and sells with its pumps, so dropping it would weaken the main business.
Air-assisted airless technology extends the firm's existing atomisation expertise, and its own engineering can refine the gun based on feedback from demanding coating applications.

The data logger relies on electronics and digital knowledge farther from the firm's mechanical core, and its demotion from its own page to a mention in 2019 signals weak traction, but it still complements the coating equipment and supports digital development, so the firm keeps it for now with elevated risk.
